checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Supplied top-down latte photo remains base of square output
Short coherent English caption visibly added
must.why: Headline and small line are in the image, but both are garbled.

must.item: Caption warm coffee tone and readable
must.why: Tone fits and the headline is readable, but the text has errors. The bottom line is tiny and low contrast.

must.item: Latte and leaf foam art visible and unobscured
must.why: Text sits clear of the cup.

must.item: No logo, price, discount or sales info

faults.what: The headline reads 'Slow morniiings,' with an extra 'i' and the word 'Slow mornings' is garbled. The chat said the headline was 'Slow mornings, good coffee'.
The bottom line reads 'Freshly make, every day'. 'Freshly made' is misspelled or altered, and the text is tiny and low contrast against the bright marble.
The colour grade is heavy and changes the marble to a yellow-pink tone.

summary: The latte photo is kept with a warm grade and clear space around the cup, but the headline is misspelled ('morniiings') and the small line reads 'Freshly make', so it can't be posted as is.
